name: Network threat hunting
thesis: Hunt C2, DNS tunneling, and lateral movement from packet capture to a defensible detection.

contract.note: The evidence manifest is unchanged. The first network delivery adds a flow.suspicious alert kind in a v1.1 revision; it is not part of the validated Apsis contract yet.

stages.name: Capture lab
stages.detail: Zeek and Suricata telemetry from approved public PCAPs.
stages.evidence: PCAP source, license, SHA-256, capture window, and the sensor configuration.

stages.name: Hunt set
stages.detail: Five hypotheses: C2 beaconing, DNS tunneling, lateral movement, staging, and TLS or JA3.
stages.evidence: One hypothesis file per hunt with the query, window, reviewed flows, and verdict.

stages.name: Detections
stages.detail: Five network detections with ATT&CK mapping and evidence.
stages.evidence: Rule, query, matched flows, ATT&CK technique, and the false-positive note.

stages.name: Reports
stages.detail: Two full hunt reports and one PCAP-to-detection walkthrough.
stages.evidence: Case narrative, timeline, verdict, containment, and lessons.

stages.name: Penumbra handoff
stages.detail: One alert, one evidence manifest, one case, and the copied contracts delivered to integrations/network/.
stages.evidence: Contract-valid alert.json, evidence.json, case.md, response.md, capture.json, and schema/.

requirements.detail: One penumbra.alert/v1 finding. The flow.suspicious kind arrives with the v1.1 revision.
One penumbra.evidence/v1 manifest with flow events and the edge facts behind the finding.
PCAP source, license, SHA-256, capture window, sensor, and retention note.
The narrative from capture to verdict, including what was benign and why.
Containment or blocking guidance for the traffic and the hosts that produced it.
The alert and evidence contracts copied into the folder so the handoff is self-contained.

how: The network lab owns capture, parsing, hunting, and the verdict. Penumbra owns intake, triage, response, and casework. The connector is the evidence manifest, not a shared database or a cross-repository import.
